title: Efficient and hardware-friendly neural architecture search with SpaceEvo
description: A persistent challenge in deep learning is optimizing neural network models for diverse hardware configurations, balancing performance and low latency. Learn how SpaceEvo automates hardware-aware neural architecture search to fine-tune DNN models for swift execution on diverse devices. The post Efficient and hardware-friendly neural architecture search with SpaceEvo appeared first on Microsoft Research .
